Ryan — thanks for the note and the timeline. Happy to move quickly. To create the vendor master we typically need:

- Legal business name (as registered with tax authority)
- Entity type (LLC / Corporation / Partnership / Sole prop)
- Tax ID / EIN (or VAT ID if outside US)
- Remit address for invoices
- AP/billing contact (name + email)
- Preferred PO channel (email vs. Coupa/Ariba)
- Bank details (ACH/wire) or a W-9/W-8BEN for tax paperwork

I've attached our short vendor intake PDF — if you fill the fields and return, Marissa (AP) will validate bank details and create the master record. Karthik (legal) is copied on later messages for entity review when you return the docs.

If it's faster, you can reply with the details inline and attach W-9 + bank instructions.
